g.text: ID57 two-frame pilot: fixed training-selected morphology
First radial-band fold displayed; both folds retained in CSV. Illumination choice and signal/background use training only.
The 65-profile sensitivity grid is hypothetical; improved prediction does not identify the measured probe or streak source.
